title: Research: exact complete frame ceiling for the selected k8 word
body:
Changing the frame of every gate in the selected k8 word still cannot beat its existing favorable packing ceiling, so frame reassignment alone cannot meet the revision-3 5% improvement target. This is a scoped negative result; it proposes no new kappa.

The certificate covers all 5,413 A/B/early-cleanup gate frames of the source-pinned R480 word, with scalar chronology, endpoints, centre cut and tail membership fixed. Complete subspace enumeration leaves 1,741 free gates in 135 components. Exact rational duals check all 23,004 LP columns and match the selected paid profile at the ceiling endpoint and 5% target. Combining this local lower bound with the existing coverage law and ideal idle packing retains `a < 0.001690054109089` (balanced planning `kappa < 1690054109089/1001690054109089`). This also covers different legal frame assignments in different invocations.

`research/selected-k8-frame-ceiling` includes the proof, complete duals, a separate bitset/covector/integer-root implementation, unchanged source copies, explicit replay manifest, controls and open next questions. Navinor's X4 frame method is retained and credited; the contribution is the different selected word's complete certificate and separate checker. Credit also chafreaky/PR557, ntedvs/PR776, Rohan Guliani/PR815, Douglas Colkitt/PR1240, Sagar Thakrar/PR1012, Arham Tahir/PR1605, the selected construction lineage, and Aaron Wang/navinor's complementary climb-pair census in [Discussion1659](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1659#discussioncomment-18916048).

Validation:
- Full registered Python 3.12 replay passed, including all 14 control groups and native audits on 704 columns in both orientations for the baseline and a distinct all-upper-frame assignment.
- Both mathematical checkers passed under Python 3.14.4 with `-I -O -B` in a relocated read-only copy; package bytes remained unchanged.
- Source pins, metadata, the 24-file package scope, and clean patch application passed. Canonical receipt: `a65d7a10aed29d7d112bb12aff0a1b0466b632cd38be068f7860bf15e5f3d265`.
- Final overlap refresh covered 499 open PRs and 318 discussion records with complete pagination; relevant PR heads were rechecked. Main `5cff33057a2b35adb90dddd5084d748ec66201eb` preserves the selected record, task catalogue, instructions, replay hook and all nine retained inputs.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-k8-frame-ceiling`.

Mathematical commit: `11fbeaf34609147c124323c2f5e74fc450dad931`. Base: `a73173f77596b0a1a115b9fed82b65183e20f7ad`. One revision-3 random draw, nonce `600a2fb184f55021a1cd62892ce3a7aa`, `complex-mechanisms / complex-rank-shape-decoder`; no reroll. Claim: [Discussion1659](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1659).

Scope excludes scalar rewrites, gate reordering, changed endpoints/helper inventories, shared centre work and changed coverage laws. This does not assert frame optimality at every exponent, eliminate remaining packing headroom, or supply a full selected cold replay, native/global admission or complete multiplication theorem. Local passes are not a GitHub CI result. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review.
